about.001.en: About bazifor.me — Classical Methods, Checkable Answers
about.001.zh: 关于 bazifor.me：古法为本，答案可查

about.002.en: bazifor.me is a deterministic BaZi and fengshui engine: classical rules encoded and cited, validated against a paid professional audit, built for families making real decisions.
about.002.zh: bazifor.me 是一个确定性的八字与风水引擎：古法规则编码成程序并注明出处，对照一份付费专业风水评估报告做过验证，为需要做实际决定的家庭而建。

about.004.en: Classical methods, checkable answers. A deterministic engine that cites every rule it applies.
about.004.zh: 古法为本，答案可查。一个会为所用的每条规则注明出处的确定性引擎。

about.014.en: bazifor.me began with a family question and an engineer's irritation. The question: which bedroom should each child sleep in, which way should the beds point, when should we move? The irritation: every answer available was either a paid consultation you had to take on faith, or an AI chatbot that produced different answers each time you asked.
about.014.zh: bazifor.me 起于一个家庭的疑问，和一位工程师的恼火。疑问是：每个孩子该睡哪间房，床头朝哪个方向，什么时候搬家？恼火的是：能找到的答案，要么是只能凭信任的付费咨询，要么是每问一次就换一个答案的 AI 聊天机器人。

about.021.zh: 。有规则，有表格，有先后次序。所以我们做了工程师会做的事：

about.022.en: encoded the procedures, tested them against benchmarks, and made every output cite its source.
about.022.zh: 把流程编成代码，用基准来检验，并让每一项输出都注明来源。

about.028.en: A reading you cannot check is a performance. Each line of a bazifor.me reading names the classical rule that produced it — so you can look the rule up, disagree with the school, or verify the arithmetic.
about.028.zh: 无法核对的解读，只是一场表演。bazifor.me 解读里的每一句话，都会写明所依据的古法规则，所以你可以查证规则、不认同某个流派的说法，也可以自己验算。

about.029.en: 3 · No AI guesswork at reading time.
about.029.zh: 3 · 解读时不靠 AI 猜测。

about.030.en: No large language model generates your results. The engine is deterministic: same input, same output, forever — which is what makes validation possible at all.
about.030.zh: 没有任何大语言模型生成你的结果。引擎是确定性的：输入相同，输出永远相同，这正是验证得以成立的前提。

about.032.en: we reproduced a professionally produced, paid fengshui audit to the digit — 27/27 flying-star palaces, 32/32 directional assignments — and match commercial chart products character-for-character on the calendar layer. That standard is only meetable by a system that computes.
about.032.zh: 我们复现了一份专业出具的付费风水评估报告，精确到每一个数字：27/27 个飞星宫位、32/32 项方位判定全部吻合；在历法层面，与商业排盘产品逐字一致。只有真正在计算的系统，才达得到这个标准。

about.034.en: Families making real decisions: choosing between homes, allocating bedrooms, pointing beds and desks, naming a baby, picking a renovation window or a moving date. The tools handle up to eight people and six homes in one private workspace, in English and Simplified Chinese (
